welcomeMessage: Hi! I'm your virtual assistant. I can help answer common questions. If you need to speak with a human, just let me know!
fallbackMessage: I'm not sure I understand. Would you like me to connect you with a human support agent?
escalationMessage: I'll connect you with a support agent right away. Please wait a moment...

faq.response: Hello! How can I help you today?
Our support team is available Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM EST. Our chatbot is available 24/7 for common questions!
You can reach us via this chat, or email us at support@example.com. We typically respond within 24 hours.
Standard shipping takes 5-7 business days. Express shipping is 2-3 business days. You'll receive a tracking number once your order ships.
We offer a 30-day return policy. Items must be unused and in original packaging. Contact us to initiate a return and we'll provide a return label.
Our pricing varies by product/service. Could you tell me what specific item or service you're interested in?
For account issues, you can reset your password using the 'Forgot Password' link on the login page. If you're still having trouble, I can connect you with a support agent.
We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, and bank transfers. For billing questions about a specific charge, I'd recommend speaking with a support agent.
You're welcome! Is there anything else I can help you with?
Thank you for chatting with us! Have a great day. Feel free to reach out anytime you need help.
